issues.on_page: Cash and cash equivalents 134,017; County treasurer cash 3,283 (Total Governmental Funds)
issues.issue: ending_cash is a computed sum (marked computed, arithmetic correct) that adds county treasurer cash to cash and cash equivalents. The 2026-11-06 ruling says cash is filled only where printed and never derived, and Osceola_FY2022 and Oshkosh_FY2022 leave county treasurer cash out. The alternative is the printed 134,017.
